notes: Mirrors the focused candidate mapping in cpp-tck.timestamped-attribute-update-future-nmra-arrival. This Java case covers one timestamped attribute-update arrival while NMRA is pending; it does not assert a GALT formula, other TSO producer paths, process-separated coordination, complete §8.11 coverage, interoperability, or conformance.

requirements.statement: While Next Message Request Available at time 10 is pending, a timestamped attribute update at time 8 remains undelivered before the publisher advances; the reflection is delivered before Time Advance Grant at time 8.
